Elena Rybakina becomes world No. 1, reaches US Open semi-finals

Elena Rybakina has secured the world No. 1 ranking in women's tennis, which will be official when rankings update on Monday. She reached the US Open semi-finals after defeating Qinwen Zheng. Her ascent to the top spot marks a significant moment for Kazakhstan in global sports.
